title: Which way does the decimal point move?
text: Percent is 'out of 100,' so multiply the decimal by 100. That moves the decimal point two places to the right. A common mistake is to move it one place, or to move it left as if you were turning a percent into a decimal. How many places does the point move?

title: Apply that shift to 0.08
text: Moving the decimal point in $$0.08$$ two places to the right produces a whole number of percent. What is that whole number?

title: Worked solution
text: $$0.08 = 8\%$$. Common mistake: answering $$80\%$$ or $$0.08\%$$. General rule: multiply by 100 to convert a decimal to a percent, and divide by 100 to convert a percent to a decimal.
